certified_invariants: Every effective Health control read compares the durable bridge projection with the current authoritative HealthControlState.
Authoritative Health read failures and missing, stale or future required Health evidence fail closed.
Authoritative baseline/policy binding mismatches, backward versions and same-version identity conflicts fail closed.
A newer, more restrictive authoritative Health state tightens effective control immediately even before durable bridge synchronization.
A newer, less restrictive authoritative Health state never relaxes risk during a read; the bridge remains the stricter authority until explicit recovery/synchronization permits relaxation.
The read overlay is defensive only and does not silently rewrite durable bridge state.
Effective evidence fingerprints bind both the bridge projection and the current authoritative Health evidence.
Capital Safety Kernel inherits the overlay and rejects unsynchronized worsening without waiting for a safety-state version bump.
OMS submit-time recheck inherits the overlay and blocks unsynchronized worsening before broker submission even when the previously approved safety-state version is unchanged.
The overlay only maintains or reduces risk and never grants order/broker authority.
explicit_non_claims: This is not R4 track certification.
